The workflow viewer uses the public Marked 18.1.1 and DOMPurify 3.4.17
bundles already distributed with api-agent. Their license texts are retained
as marked-LICENSE.txt and dompurify-LICENSE.txt.

The root locked npm install copies the unchanged official Marked UMD,
DOMPurify browser build and heading-plugin UMD into ignored runtime files.
Studio uses the unchanged official ESM builds. No export rewriting, runtime CDN
or first-view download is performed. Original copyright/license headers and
notices remain intact; prepared Python distributions include all required files.

PlantUML is an optional development renderer and is not bundled in the
application wheel. PlantUML-NOTICE.txt records the pinned MIT JAR's own
`-license` output and its bundled component acknowledgements.

Heading identifiers use the original marked-gfm-heading-id 4.1.4 UMD build,
which includes github-slugger 2.0.0. Their MIT and ISC notices are preserved
in heading-id-LICENSE.txt and github-slugger-LICENSE.txt respectively.
Upstream: https://github.com/markedjs/marked-gfm-heading-id
Upstream: https://github.com/Flet/github-slugger
